title: Petition of Boston-Worcester Express Corporation of Everett, Massachusetts, for a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity under the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 7, as amended, to authorize the operation of motor vehicles to be used in the carriage of passengers for hire, restricted to those people traveling to and from the Copley Plaza Hotel, the Back Bay Hilton Hotel, the Sheraton Boston Hotel and the Howard Johnson - Fifty-Seven Hotel in the City of Boston.
